_comment: Shared test cases for the ComfyUI install guard (N2 of the phase 9 design). A path may be written or deleted only when it is inside the install folder by real path (links resolved), the install folder has VGAC's marker file (vgac-install.json with made_by VGAC), and it is not inside, or around, a ComfyUI folder VGAC did not install (the fence). Each case builds a small tree under a temporary folder with `setup` steps, then asks about `target`. Steps: mkdir <path>; file <path>; marker <folder> (writes vgac-install.json there); junction <link> <target> (a directory junction, made with mklink /J). All paths are relative to the temporary folder. `root` is the install folder; `fence` lists foreign ComfyUI folders. `expect` is allow or refuse. Used by the starter's C# tests today and by the backend's Python tests (backend/vgac/comfy_install.py guard) once they read it.

cases.name: beside with the same name prefix
a junction inside leads to another place inside
inside a foreign ComfyUI that is fenced off
a fenced folder inside the install folder (the person's shared models)
a target that does not exist yet
